description: This file defines an abstract base class 'FeatureAndSnippetBase' in the PdfSharp.Quality namespace, providing common functionality for generating and manipulating PDF documents and images, including methods for creating pages, adding content, and comparing render results. It also includes enums and constants related to PDF page dimensions and drawing options.

classes.name: FeatureAndSnippetBase
classes.description: An abstract base class providing shared functionality for PDF feature and snippet generation, including methods for creating and managing PDF documents, pages, graphics, and images.

methods.name: BeginPdfDocument
methods.description: Initializes a new PDF document with preset author and layout settings.

methods.name: EndPdfDocument
methods.description: Finalizes the PDF document and saves it to a byte array.

methods.name: BeginPdfPage
methods.description: Creates a new PDF page with specified dimensions and graphics settings.

methods.name: GenerateParallelComparisonDocument
methods.description: Creates a PDF for comparing two render results side by side.

methods.name: GenerateSerialComparisonDocument
methods.description: Creates a PDF for comparing two render results sequentially.

methods.name: DrawPdfToBox
methods.description: Draws PDF content from byte array into specified graphics box.

methods.name: DrawImageToBox
methods.description: Draws image content from byte array into specified graphics box.

methods.name: DrawEmptyBox
methods.description: Draws a red rectangle and diagonal line inside a given box to indicate empty content.

methods.name: SaveAndShowFile
methods.description: Saves byte array content to a file and optionally opens it in a viewer.

methods.name: GetFileExtension
methods.description: Determines the file extension based on the source byte array.

methods.name: BeginImage
methods.description: Initializes image drawing context, either WPF or GDI+ depending on platform.

methods.name: EndPngImage
methods.description: Finalizes and saves PNG image bytes.
